name: print-social-fashtrend-pack-grey-and-cobalt-with-serif-sale-panels
title: Fashtrend nine-post pack in pale grey and cobalt with serif titles and offset photo panels
whatItIs: A 3x3 grid of pale grey square posts with cobalt blue blocks, black serif headlines ('New Arrivals', 'Casual Pants', 'Big Discount 60% Off'), greyscale fashion photos offset over blue panels, small promo-code boxes and square 'Shop now' buttons.
whatItMeans: Crisp and stylish; one cobalt accent on grey feels like a boutique catalogue.
techniques: Offset photos over solid colour blocks.
Use one saturated accent against neutral grey.
Pair a serif title with small sans details.
Vary layouts while keeping palette fixed across a grid.

vocabulary.definition: A colour block shifted behind a photo.
Posts designed to look cohesive as a 3x3 profile grid.
